issue_body:
# Performance below threshold - project detail pages (persistent, 5+ cycles)

Audited: **2026-10-04T14:05:38.207Z**

## Affected pages

| Page | Perf | LCP | TBT |
|---|---|---|---|
| `/projects/note-structurer` | 83 (was 80) | 4147 ms | 94 ms |
| `/projects/screenshot-to-primevue` | 79 (was 77) | 4585 ms | 110 ms |

> `/` (91), `/about` (90), and `/projects` (90) are all comfortably above threshold - home page has fully recovered.

## Why this matters
Both project detail pages have been below the 85 performance threshold for **at least 5 consecutive audit cycles** with no material LCP improvement. LCP on `/projects/screenshot-to-primevue` is essentially unchanged at ~4.6 s across multiple runs. TBT has improved on both pages this cycle, confirming LCP is the sole remaining bottleneck. This is a persistent structural issue, not noise.

## Recommended fixes
1. **Convert hero/LCP images to WebP or AVIF** with correct `srcset` / `sizes` to reduce initial payload on both pages.
2. **Add `fetchpriority="high"`** to the LCP image element so the browser prioritises it earlier in the load waterfall.
3. **Preconnect or preload** critical third-party origins (fonts, CDN assets) that may be adding latency before LCP.
4. **Code-split** any non-critical JS bundles on project pages to reduce time-to-interactive and indirectly help LCP.

## Visual status
All pages are visually intact on desktop and mobile - no layout breakage, overflow, missing sections, or contrast issues detected.
